title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: optimalvalue
text:
optimal value
optimal value
(definition)
Definition:
The minimum (or maximum) value of the
objective function
over the
feasible region
of an
optimization problem
.
See also
optimal solution
.
Note:
